title: observability: token-level cost/latency dashboards + alert tuning and tracing enhancements
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: Improve per-request/token observability to make cost and latency regressions actionable for serving runtime and routing decisions. This PR adds token-level cost and latency metrics (prefix vs. generation split), updates Grafana dashboards with new breakdowns, tunes alert thresholds for bursty workloads, and adds additional tracing tags for KV cache and batching to make traces linkable to token metrics. Changes were driven by ENG-4821 and follow-up from an incident where high-cost tail latency was not visible at token granularity. Summary of changes: added new Prometheus exporters for token metrics, instrumented runtime batching and KV cache paths with span tags, created a token-cost/latency Grafana dashboard with per-model and per-route panels, added alert rules for token-latency P95/P99 and cost-per-token regressions, and documented tuning guidance in the observability runbook. Checklist: - [x] Add token-level metrics (counters, histograms, labels) - [x] Instrument tracing for KV cache hits/misses and batch sizes - [x] Dashboards with breakdowns by model, route, allocation (dedicated vs hosted) - [x] Alerts with noise-reduction windowing and escalation paths - [x] Run CI and integration tests - [x] Update runbook and rollout plan Rollout plan: deploy metrics and tracing instrumentation behind feature flag, roll out dashboards to staging Grafana, enable alerts in a monitoring-sandbox PD routing for 24h, then move to production PD channel if no noise. Observability owners: @Ethan Park (dashboards), @Lina Sanchez (alerts), @Priya Menon (metrics/tracing). Implementation notes: metrics use a stable label set (model_name, model_variant, route, deployment_tier, request_phase) to ensure cardinality control; histograms use custom buckets tuned from production token length distributions; alerts use a rolling 5m evaluation with 30m suppression for transient spikes. Related: ENG-4876 (alert tuning playbook), SUP-914 (customer-reported high token cost).
